watches.name: Hands On
watches.description: Try our watches on in person at a small, select event. NEXT EVENT: 27 October 2026 — Central London (5pm-9pm GMT) Hands On is Edward Christopher® — up close and personal. Once in a while, we take our whole collection and bring it to a room near you — for free. No screens, no waiting for a courier, and no entry fee. Just watches on your wrists, and someone right there to talk about what our timepieces are really about. You'll meet Seán, the man who started all this, and hear the story of Edward and Christopher, the two men this brand is named after, who each saved a child's life; and the reason why £35 from every product we sell is automatically donated to one of two charities helping children & young people in need . Then it's hands on — quite literally. Try on as many pieces as you like. Ask whatever questions you want about our commercial, creative or charitable ethos. Fall in love with one...or several watches. And if you want to pre-order or order and, when the stock's on hand, walk away with one or more watches, there and then, then you can! We keep it small on purpose — only up to 5 of you at a time for up to half an hour — because a proper conversation doesn't always work in a crowd. No pitch and no pressure. Come for the watches. Stay for the story. Walk away with what you want.

watches.name: The Ripple — Electric Blue (Special Edition)
watches.description: 25 individually numbered pieces. One dial that stops conversations. One purpose that starts them. Some watches tell the time. This one tells the room you've arrived, and that you brought something with you that not only looks and makes you feel good, but also does serious good. The Ripple Electric Blue (Special Edition) is the new, even bolder sibling of our Ripple Imperial Violet (Special Edition) which sold out in 72 hours. A mirrored 3D dial sends ripples out from our lumed motif. Electric blue hands cut through them. Turn it over and a matching blue rotor glows in the dark, long after the room goes quiet. We designed it from scratch. And £35 automatically goes from us with every order to children and young people in need. You choose which of the two charities our donation goes to .

specsRaw.Operation Orphan: Everything we receive is used to directly strengthen the care structure of orphans.

watches.name: The Ripple — Imperial Violet (Special Edition)
watches.description: Twenty-five numbered pieces. The Ripple Special Edition - (Imperial Violet) was the watch that proved the point. A fully mirrored 3D rippled dial — sculpted in polished steel, hypnotic under any light — with violet hands and a violet-finished exhibition rotor that glows in the dark long after the room goes quiet. 38mm. Miyota 9039 automatic movement. 42-hour power reserve. Sapphire exhibition caseback. Integrated bracelet. Custom-made from scratch. Fully British.

watches.name: The Manta Revelare — Sky Blue Edition
watches.description: Winner of a GOOD DESIGN Award and home to the world's first Manta Ray shaped rotor, the Revelare is a 40mm Swiss automatic sports watch with a sapphire crystal exhibition caseback that makes every glance a moment. Revelare — to reveal. Swiss Sellita movement. Internal rotating bidirectional bezel. Two colour-coded crowns. Triple-coated anti-glare sapphire crystal. 200m water resistance. Custom-made from scratch. Fully British. Sky Blue is the colour of open water and clear thinking. For the person who moves through the world with quiet, unhurried confidence.

specsRaw.Case construction: 4-piece marine grade stainless steel with a screw-down case back
specsRaw.Case Back (open): A custom made rotor in the shape of a Manta Ray underneath a flat scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with an anti-glare coating.
specsRaw.Bezel: Internal rotating bi-directional bezel, in aluminium, with the numerals illuminated by a blue-green Super-LumiNova BGW9 luminance for easy reading in low light
specsRaw.Crystals: The flat scratch-resistant sapphire crystal is triple coated with anti-glare coating on both sides...and is fitted with hidden O-ring gaskets
specsRaw.Dial: The colour-coded brass dial is painted with a hydraulically stamped 3D kaleidoscope guilloché style pattern with applied indexes which are illuminated by blue BGW9 lume
specsRaw.Strap: Custom made quick-release 2-piece FKM vulcanised rubber strap with 2 keepers fitted with a branded stainless steel buckle. Fits wrist sizes: 13cm-20cm.

specsRaw.Strap: Custom made quick-release 2-piece FKM vulcanised rubber strap with 2 keepers fitted with a branded stainless steel buckle. Fits wrist sizes: 13cm-20cm.
specsRaw.Movement: Swiss Sellita SW200-1b (26 jewels) self-winding mechanical movement
specsRaw.Time hacking: Yes (second hand can be stopped for synchronising)
specsRaw.Hands: Custom made hands painted matt black and white illuminated by a blue-green Super-LumiNova BGW9 luminance for easy reading in low light
specsRaw.Operation Orphan: Everything we receive is used to directly strengthen the care structure of orphans.
specsRaw.KIDSCAPE CAMPAIGN FOR CHILDREN'S SAFETY: Help Kidscape give a bullied child their life back
